movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC) and Citrix NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for a denial of service.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Zammad GmbH Zammad Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that can allow the local zammad user to escalate privileges to root. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102489.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Zammad GmbH Zammad Session Fixation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to gain unauthorized access to sensitive functionality and perform unauthorized operations.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: iCagenda Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: iCagenda contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows the upload of arbitrary files in the file attachment feature, ultimately resulting in PHP code upload and execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: SolarWinds Serv-U Uncontrolled Resource Consumption Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: SolarWinds Serv-U contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows specially crafted POST requests using the Content-Encoding: deflate header to crash the Serv-U service without authentication.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Mirasvit Full Page Cache Warmer Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Mirasvit Full Page Cache Warmer contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by supplying a crafted serialized PHP object in the CacheWarmer cookie.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin contains privilege escalation vulnerability that is exposed via the user-end cPanel plugin, which can be abused by any cPanel user account to execute arbitrary scripts with root privileges.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Broadcom VMware vCenter Server Out-of-bounds Write Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Broadcom VMware vCenter Server contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the implementation of the DCERPC protocol. This could allow a malicious actor with network access to vCenter Server to send specially crafted network packets, potentially leading to remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Multi-Router Looking Glass (MRLG) Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Multi-Router Looking Glass (MRLG) contains a buffer overflow vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause an arbitrary memory write and memory corruption.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: TP-Link Multiple Routers Command Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: TP-Link TL-WR940N V2/V4, TL-WR841N V8/V10, and TL-WR740N V1/V2 contain a command injection vulnerability via the component /userRpm/WlanNetworkRpm. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: ASUS RT-AX55 Routers OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: ASUS RT-AX55 devices contain an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote, authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands. As represented by CVE-2023-41346.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet Multiple Products Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiFone, FortiVoice, FortiNDR and FortiMail contain a stack-based overflow vulnerability that may allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code or commands via crafted HTTP requests.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: GeoVision Devices OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Multiple GeoVision devices contain an OS command injection vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to inject and execute arbitrary system commands. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Advantive VeraCore SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Advantive VeraCore contains a SQL injection vulnerability in timeoutWarning.asp that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary SQL commands via the PmSess1 parameter.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: VMware ESXi Arbitrary Write Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: VMware ESXi contains an arbitrary write vulnerability. Successful exploitation allows an attacker with privileges within the VMX process to trigger an arbitrary kernel write leading to an escape of the sandbox.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Cloud Services Appliance (CSA) OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Ivanti Cloud Services Appliance (CSA) contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the administrative console which can allow an authenticated attacker with application admin privileges to pass commands to the underlying OS.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute code via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Roundcube Webmail Persistent Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Roundcube Webmail contains a persistent cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to run malicious JavaScript code.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Integer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Apple iOS. iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS contain an integer overflow vulnerability that could allow an application to execute code with kernel privileges.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Zyxel Multiple Firewalls Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Zyxel ATP, USG FLEX, USG FLEX 50(W), USG20(W)-VPN, VPN, and ZyWALL/USG firewalls contain a buffer overflow vulnerability in the notification function that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to cause denial-of-service (DoS) conditions and remote code execution on an affected device.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Zyxel Multiple Firewalls Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Zyxel ATP, USG FLEX, USG FLEX 50(W), USG20(W)-VPN, VPN, and ZyWALL/USG firewalls contain a buffer overflow vulnerability in the ID processing function that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to cause denial-of-service (DoS) conditions and remote code execution on an affected device.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Mitel MiVoice Connect Code Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: The Director component in Mitel MiVoice Connect allows an authenticated attacker with internal network access to execute code within the context of the application.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Mitel MiVoice Connect Command Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: The Mitel Edge Gateway component of MiVoice Connect allows an authenticated attacker with internal network access to execute commands within the context of the system.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an attacker to gain SYSTEM-level privileges.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: GIGABYTE Multiple Products Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: The GPCIDrv and GDrv low-level drivers in GIGABYTE App Center, AORUS Graphics Engine, XTREME Gaming Engine, and OC GURU II expose functionality to read/write data from/to IO ports. This could be leveraged in a number of ways to ultimately run code with elevated privileges.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: The overlayfs stacking file system in Linux kernel does not properly validate the application of file capabilities against user namespaces, which could lead to privilege escalation.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: The get_user and put_user API functions of the Linux kernel fail to validate the target address when being used on ARM v6k/v7 platforms. This allows an application to read and write kernel memory which could lead to privilege escalation.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute code via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Acrobat and Reader Unspecified Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Adobe Acrobat and Reader contains an unespecified vulnerability described as a design flaw which could allow a specially crafted file to be printed silently an arbitrary number of times.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A remote code execution vulnerability exists when components of Windows, .NET Framework, Office, Lync, and Silverlight fail to properly handle TrueType fonts.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: QNAP NAS File Station Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A cross-site scripting vulnerability affecting QNAP NAS File Station could allow remote attackers to inject malicious code.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Update Notification Manager Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Update Notification Manager contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird Type Confusion Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird contain a type confusion vulnerability that can occur when manipulating JavaScript objects due to issues in Array.pop, allowing for an exploitable crash.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows AppX Deployment Service Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when Windows AppX Deployment Service (AppXSVC) improperly handles hard links.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: WhatsApp VOIP Stack Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A buffer overflow vulnerability in WhatsApp VOIP stack allowed remote code execution via specially crafted series of RTCP packets sent to a target phone number.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Checkbox Survey Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in CheckboxWeb.dll of Checkbox Survey allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Ruby on Rails Directory Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Directory traversal vulnerability in actionpack/lib/abstract_controller/base.rb in the implicit-render implementation in Ruby on Rails allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files via a crafted request.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows AppX Deployment Service (AppXSVC) Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when Windows AppXSVC improperly handles hard links. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could run processes in an elevated context.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft PowerPoint Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft PowerPoint allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code or cause a denial of service (memory corruption) via a crafted Office document.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Reader and Acrobat Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Adobe Reader and Acrobat contain a use-after-free vulnerability which can allow for code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apple OS X Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Heap-based buffer overflow in IOHIDFamily in Apple OS X, which affects, iOS before 8 and Apple TV before 7, allows attackers to execute arbitrary code in a privileged context.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apache Struts 1 ActionForm Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: ActionForm in Apache Struts versions before 1.2.9 with BeanUtils 1.7 contains a vulnerability that allows for denial-of-service (DoS).

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: FatPipe WARP, IPVPN, and MPVPN Configuration Upload exploit
movers24h.shortDescription: A vulnerability in the web management interface of FatPipe WARP, IPVPN, and MPVPN software allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to upload a file to any location on the filesystem.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows AppX Installer Spoofing Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows AppX Installer contains a spoofing vulnerability which has a high impacts to confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Kernel/ptrace.c in Linux kernel mishandles contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that allows local users to obtain root access.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Docker Desktop Community Edition Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Docker Desktop Community Edition contains a vulnerability that may allow local users to escalate privileges by placing a trojan horse docker-credential-wincred.exe file in %PROGRAMDATA%\DockerDesktop\version-bin\.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium Indexed DB API Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Google Chromium Indexed DB API contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows a remote attacker, who has compromised the renderer process, to potentially perform a sandbox escape via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Incorrect Resource Transfer Between Spheres Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an incorrect resource transfer between spheres vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apache Tomcat Missing Encryption of Sensitive Data Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Apache Tomcat contains a missing encryption of sensitive data vulnerability that allows the bypass of the EncryptInterceptor. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE‑2025‑24813.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apache ActiveMQ Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Apache ActiveMQ contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows for code injection.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Out-of-Bounds Read Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC), NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) and NetScaler ADC FIPS and NDcPP contain an out-of-bounds reads vulnerability when configured as a SAML IDP leading to memory overread.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: BerriAI LiteLLM SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: BerriAI LiteLLM contains a SQL injection vulnerability that allows an attacker to read data from the proxy's database and potentially modify it, leading to unauthorized access to the proxy and the credentials it manages.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Drupal Core SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Drupal Core contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation and remote code execution via specially crafted requests sent with the database abstraction API.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Ubiquiti UniFi OS Improper Access Control Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Ubiquiti UniFi OS contains an improper access control vulnerability which could allow a malicious actor with access to the network to make unauthorized changes to the system.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Langflow Code Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Langflow contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow building public flows without requiring authentication.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Exchange Server Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Exchange Server contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability during web page generation in Outlook Web Access and when certain interaction conditions are met, arbitrary JavaScript can be executed in the browser context.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions Double Free Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions contains a double free vulnerability that could enable remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: SimpleHelp Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: SimpleHelp contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the OIDC authentication flow. When OIDC authentication is configured, identity tokens submitted during login are accepted without verifying their cryptographic signature. In a vulnerable configuration, a remote, unauthenticated attacker can submit a forged token containing arbitrary identity claims to obtain a fully authenticated technician session. In some configurations, this may also allow bypass of multi-factor authentication.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Widget Factory Joomla Content Editor Improper Access Control Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Widget Factory Joomla Content Editor contains an improper access control vulnerability which could allow for upload and execution of PHP code via the creation of new editor profiles for unauthenticated users.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Ubiquiti UniFi OS Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Ubiquiti UniFi OS contains a path traversal vulnerability which could allow a malicious actor with access to the network to access files on the underlying system that could be manipulated to access an underlying account.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Defender Denial of Service Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Defender contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for denial of service.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Kludex Starlette HTTP Request/Response Smuggling Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Kludex Starlette contains a HTTP request/response smuggling vulnerability that could allow attackers to inject paths into the host part, prepending the actual path leading to issues such as authentication bypass when the authentication depends on the reconstructed URL’s path. This vulnerability could be chaned with CVE-2026-42271.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SharePoint Server Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft SharePoint Server contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability which allows an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Marimo Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Marimo contains an pre-authorization remote code execution vulnerability, allowing an unauthenticated attacked to shell access and execute arbitrary system commands.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Protection Mechanism Failure Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Shell contains a protection mechanism failure vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution or denial of service

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Ahsay AhsayCBS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute operating system commands via manipulation of the random parameter in the Replication Receiver component’s /rps/api/json/UpdateReceivers.do endpoint. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105133.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Ahsay AhsayCBS Improper Authentication Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to bypass authentication via manipulation of the random parameter in the API component’s checkSysPwd function. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105134.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Atlassian Multiple Products Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Multiple Atlassian products (Bitbucket Data Center ,Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center, Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye) contain a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access specific files within the web application root directory in affected versions.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Identity Services Engine Incorrect Use of Privileged APIs Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco ISE Passive Identity Connector (ISE-PIC) contain an incorrect use of privileged APIs vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to gain unauthorized access to the affected device by bypassing the web-based management interface.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Aquasecurity Trivy Embedded Malicious Code Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Aquasecurity Trivy contains an embedded malicious code vulnerability that could allow an attacker to gain access to everything in the CI/CD environment, including all tokens, SSH keys, cloud credentials, database passwords, and any sensitive configuration in memory.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiSandbox OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiSandbox contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via crafted HTTP requests.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Ubiquiti UniFi OS Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Ubiquiti UniFi OS contains an improper input validation vulnerability which could allow a malicious actor with access to the network to conduct command injection.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: SolarWinds Serv-U Uncontrolled Resource Consumption Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: SolarWinds Serv-U contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows specially crafted POST requests using the Content-Encoding: deflate header to crash the Serv-U service without authentication.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: WordPress Core Remote File Inclusion Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: WordPress Core contains a remote file inclusion vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to make page-template resolution include a chosen readable local `.php` file outside the active theme directories, leading to remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Hex Encoding Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a hex encoding vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access an affected system with privileges of the admin user due to improper handling of URI encoding in an HTTP request.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows a remotely authenticated user with administrative access to achieve remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Shell Protection Mechanism Failure Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Shell contains a protection mechanism failure vulnerability that could allow an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium Out of Bounds Memory Access Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Google Chromium contains an out of bounds memory access vulnerability in ANGLE that could allow a remote attacker to perform out of bounds memory access via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the Image I/O framework.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Flash Player Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Stack-based buffer overflow in Adobe Flash Player allows attackers to execute code remotely.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Mirasvit Full Page Cache Warmer Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Mirasvit Full Page Cache Warmer contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by supplying a crafted serialized PHP object in the CacheWarmer cookie.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Apple iOS, macOS, and iPadOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in CoreGraphics that may lead to arbitrary code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Progress LoadMaster Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Progress LoadMaster contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an un-authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the LoadMaster appliance by exploiting unsanitized input in multiple command endpoints.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Trend Micro Apex One (On-Premise) Directory Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Trend Micro Apex One (on-premise) contains a directory traversal vulnerability that could allow a pre-authenticated local attacker to modify a key table on the server to inject malicious code to deploy to agents on affected installations.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin contains privilege escalation vulnerability that is exposed via the user-end cPanel plugin, which can be abused by any cPanel user account to execute arbitrary scripts with root privileges.

movers7d.product: Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS)
movers7d.vulnerabilityName: BeyondTrust Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS) OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: BeyondTrust Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS) contain an OS command injection vulnerability that can be exploited by an attacker with existing administrative privileges to upload a malicious file. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can allow a remote attacker to execute underlying operating system commands within the context of the site user.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Google Dawn Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Google Dawn contains an use-after-free vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker who had compromised the renderer process to execute arbitrary code via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple Chromium-based products including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability if WebEx zimlet installed and zimlet JSP is enabled.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Use-After-Free WebKit Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and other Apple products contain a use-after-free vulnerability in WebKit. Processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to memory corruption. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Defender Link Following Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Defender contains a link following vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Qlik Sense HTTP Tunneling Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Qlik Sense contains an HTTP tunneling vulnerability that allows an attacker to escalate privileges and execute HTTP requests on the backend server hosting the software.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apache Superset Insecure Default Initialization of Resource Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Apache Superset contains an insecure default initialization of a resource vulnerability that allows an attacker to authenticate and access unauthorized resources on installations that have not altered the default configured SECRET_KEY according to installation instructions.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Sitecore CMS and Experience Platform (XP) Deserialization Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Sitecore CMS and Experience Platform (XP) contain a deserialization vulnerability in the Sitecore.Security.AntiCSRF module that allows an authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code by sending a serialized .NET object in the HTTP POST parameter __CSRFTOKEN.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Shell contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Google Brotli Unchecked Return Value Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Google Brotli contains an unchecked return value vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Commerce and Magento Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Adobe Commerce and Magento contain an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session.

newest.vulnerabilityName: PHP Memory Corruption Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: PHP contains an out-of-memory corruption vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: PHP Stale Internal Request-State Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: PHP contains a stale internal request-state vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server OS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Collabora Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server when used within the NextCloud platform contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution when the CODE server isn't running.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQL Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator on-prem contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

newest.vulnerabilityName: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition OS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition contains an OS command injection vulnerability which may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands with root or SYSTEM privileges on the system running the affected product.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server External Control of File Name or Path Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains an external control of file name or path vulnerability which can allow an admin user to write arbitrary files that may be executed on load. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96655.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Siemens Software Center Uncontrolled Search Path Element Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Siemens Software Center contains an uncontrolled search path element vulnerability that could allow an authenticated local attacker to place a specially crafted DLL in a directory that the application searches, leading to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the affected application.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Improper Neutralization of Encoded URI Schemes in a Web Page Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains an improper neutralization of encoded URI schemes in a web page vulnerability that could allow an attacker to call other plugins' functions and supply their own parameters. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to request arbitrary internal or external addresses via the '/video/:/transcode/universal' path parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96656.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability which could allow an attacker using any X-Plex-Token value to include a full URL in the 'protocol' parameter and force the Plex server to POST to the attacker's chosen destination. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96654, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

newest.vulnerabilityName: BeyondTrust Remote Support Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: BeyondTrust Remote Support contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform file operations on the appliance.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager contain a path traversal vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker with admin profile and at least read-write permissions to write or delete arbitrary files via specific CLI commands.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Atlassian Multiple Products Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Multiple Atlassian products (Bitbucket Data Center ,Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center, Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye) contain a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access specific files within the web application root directory in affected versions.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ahsay AhsayCBS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute operating system commands via manipulation of the random parameter in the Replication Receiver component’s /rps/api/json/UpdateReceivers.do endpoint. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105133.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ahsay AhsayCBS Improper Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to bypass authentication via manipulation of the random parameter in the API component’s checkSysPwd function. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105134.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Email Gateway Relative Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco Secure Email Gateway contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying operating system.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Code Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an authenticated attacker with network access to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Shell contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

newest.vulnerabilityName: ProFTPD Improper Access Control Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: ProFTPD contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to read and write to arbitrary files via the site cpfr and site cpto commands.

newest.vulnerabilityName: ISC BIND Data Processing Errors Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: ISC BIND contains a data processing errors vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause a denial of service via TKEY queries.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Apache Struts Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Apache Struts contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via method:prefix when Dynamic Method Invocation is enabled.

newest.vulnerabilityName: ONLYOFFICE Docs Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: ONLYOFFICE Docs contains a path traversal vulnerability that can occur when JWT is used, via a /.. sequence in an image upload parameter and could allow for remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Strapi Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Strapi contains a cleartext storage of sensitive information vulnerability that could allow attackers with access to the admin panel to discover sensitive user details via the query filter. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2023-22621 to achieve remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC) and Citrix NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for a denial of service.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Zammad GmbH Zammad Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that can allow the local zammad user to escalate privileges to root. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102489.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Zammad GmbH Zammad Session Fixation Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiMail Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiMail contains a path traversal and an improper neutralization of NULL byte or NULL character vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Hex Encoding Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a hex encoding vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access an affected system with privileges of the admin user due to improper handling of URI encoding in an HTTP request.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Apple iOS, macOS, and iPadOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in CoreGraphics that may lead to arbitrary code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution or denial of service

newest.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

newest.vulnerabilityName: WordPress Core Remote File Inclusion Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: WordPress Core contains a remote file inclusion vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to make page-template resolution include a chosen readable local `.php` file outside the active theme directories, leading to remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SharePoint Code Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Microsoft SharePoint contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Mikrotik RouterOS Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Mikrotik RouterOS contains an improper enforcement of behavioral workflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated client to open a session channel and send an exec request. This vulnerability can be chained to achieve unauthenticated exploitation of CVE-2026-86060.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Commerce and Magento Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Adobe Commerce and Magento contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an attacker to leverage this vulnerability to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without any user interaction.

newest.vulnerabilityName: WSO2 Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: WSO2 API Control Plane, API Manager, Traffic Manager & Universal Gateway contain a path traversal vulnerability that could allow for unrestricted file upload and lead to remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Check Point Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Check Point Security Management Server, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Log Server, Multi-Domain Log Server, and SmartEvent contain a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload and execute arbitrary scripts.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Check Point Multiple Products Improper Certificate Validation Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Check Point Security Gateway and Check Point Spark Firewall using Site to Site VPN or Remote Access VPN contain an improper certificate validation vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the Gateway.

newest.vulnerabilityName: F5 BIG-IP APM Heap-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: F5 BIG-IP APM contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability when access policy and an OAuth profile are configured on a virtual server. This vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated attacker to perform remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) on-prem contains an improper input validation vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Zyxel GS1900 Series Switches Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Zyxel GS1900 series switches contain a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the CGI program which could allow a LAN-based, unauthenticated attacker to exploit the flaw and potentially execute OS commands via a crafted HTTP request.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability in the TLS receive path which allows a zero-length record retrieved from the rx_list to bypass the intended recvmsg() record-type handling, potentially causing subsequent TLS records to be processed using incorrect zero-copy and queuing assumptions. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the ebtables SNAT target which allows an ARP sender hardware address rewrite to write directly into a nonlinear socket-buffer fragment backed by a splice-imported file page. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Race Condition Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains a race condition vulnerability which allows concurrent writes to the same AF_ALG socket causing data to be unpredictably interleaved and creating inconsistencies in the socket's internal state.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Identity Services Engine Incorrect Use of Privileged APIs Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco ISE Passive Identity Connector (ISE-PIC) contain an incorrect use of privileged APIs vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to gain unauthorized access to the affected device by bypassing the web-based management interface.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Google Pixel Improper Authorization Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Google Pixel devices contain an improper authorization vulnerability in the cellular modem. A logic error may allow an attacker to bypass permission checks and escalate privileges.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Acronis Backup Incorrect Default Permissions Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Acronis Backup plugin for cPanel & WHM and extension for Plesk contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation.
